observations: Three photos show long, corrugated metal roofing sheets in different colors: beige/cream, green, and black.
The sheets are stacked horizontally on metal racks or supports in what appears to be a warehouse or storage area.
The surface of the sheets has a consistent ribbed profile, typical of long-span roofing sheets.
Watermarks 'SOLANA ALUMINUM' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all photos.
No visible branding, model numbers, or thickness markings on the sheets themselves.
Photo 0 shows beige and green sheets; photo 1 shows beige sheets with a person’s legs in the background; photo 2 shows black sheets with a person standing nearby.

claims.claim: 0.70mm thickness Aluminum Long span Roofing Sheets
claims.evidence: No thickness markings or measurement tools visible in any photo. The thickness cannot be confirmed visually.

risks.risk: Actual thickness may be less than claimed 0.70mm
risks.proof: A close-up photo showing a thickness gauge or caliper measuring the sheet, or a label with thickness specification.
risks.if_unproven: priced as thinner than claimed, which reduces value

risks.risk: Material may not be pure aluminum or may be coated steel masquerading as aluminum
risks.proof: A close-up of the edge or cut section showing the material's cross-section, or a certificate of material composition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-grade material, which reduces value

risks.risk: Surface coating may be damaged or peeling, affecting durability
risks.proof: Close-up of the surface showing any scratches, chips, or flaking paint/coating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the edge or side of a sheet showing thickness or material label.
Photo of a thickness gauge or caliper measuring the sheet.
Certificate or label confirming aluminum composition and thickness.
Close-up of the surface to check for coating damage or imperfections.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as aluminum roofing sheets, but the claimed thickness of 0.70mm cannot be verified from the photos. Without proof of thickness and material authenticity, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant risk of being misrepresented.
